Síkela Says Europe Looks to Expand Development Financing
videos.description: Jozef Síkela, EU International Partnership Commissioner, says Europe is already the largest contributor to development assistance and is looking to mobilize more private capital for emerging and developing markets. Síkela says the EU’s partnership package with Greenland is aimed at strengthening security and resilience while creating jobs and economic value. Síkela says Europe wants to work with Canada to reduce critical-mineral dependence on China. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
